summary: Varonis Systems, Inc. disclosed an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated October 15, 2026 under Item 1.01, with Proofpoint, Inc. (Parent) and Vail Merger Sub, Inc., both affiliates of Thoma Bravo-advised funds. Merger Sub will merge into Varonis, which becomes a wholly owned Proofpoint subsidiary; holders receive $49.75 cash per share. The board unanimously approved and recommended the deal. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to a stockholder vote, after which shares delist from Nasdaq and deregister under the Exchange Act. Risk-arb focus: financing, regulatory approvals and any competing proposal.
